campaignWizard.title: Create a send campaign
campaignWizard.description: Add recipients, build the sequence, preview it with real lead data, then launch.

stepName.saveFailed: Could not save the campaign. Check your connection and try again.
stepName.title: Name your campaign
stepName.subtitle: Use a clear internal name so your team can find it later.
stepName.draftNote: A draft is saved when you continue. Going back edits the same draft instead of creating another campaign.

stepLeads.title: Add campaign leads
stepLeads.subtitle: Select existing people or upload a spreadsheet and map every important column.
stepLeads.fromPeopleBody: Reuse verified contacts already stored in your CRM. Existing campaign members are skipped.
stepLeads.uploadBody: Drop a file here or browse. You will review column mapping before anything is imported.
stepLeads.emailRequiredNote: Email is required. Mapped profile fields update People and Company; every unmapped column remains available as a merge variable.
stepLeads.resultSummary: {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} — {imported, number} imported{duplicates, plural, =0 {} other {, # duplicate}}{suppressed, plural, =0 {} other {, # suppressed}}{failed, plural, =0 {} other {, # failed}}

stepReview.updateFailed: Could not update the campaign. Check your connection and try again.
stepReview.finalWait: {days, plural, one {Final follow-up waits # day} other {Final follow-up waits # days}}
stepReview.title: Review and launch
stepReview.subtitle: Confirm the audience, sequence and sending readiness before the campaign goes live.
stepReview.mailboxesReady: {count, plural, one {# mailbox connected and ready to send — round-robin assignment} other {# mailboxes connected and ready to send — round-robin assignment}}
stepReview.noMailboxes: No connected mailboxes — connect one before launching
stepReview.noLeads: No leads are enrolled yet. Save as draft, or go back and add recipients before launching.
stepReview.launchBlocked: Needs a connected mailbox, a complete sequence, and at least one lead
